name: Magic Odd Square
description: Find an n × n matrix with different numbers from 1 to n 2 , so the sum in each row, column and both main diagonals are odd.
input_specification: The only line contains odd integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 49 ).
output_specification: Print n lines with n integers. All the integers should be different and from 1 to n 2 . The sum in each row, column and both main diagonals should be odd.
approach_summary: Uncover mathematical invariant or parity constraint. Construct the solution step-by-step maintaining the validity condition without exhaustive search.
